content:
FINAL LIVE VERIFICATION — CURRENT CODE ONLY

I need verified evidence for the CURRENT latest code.

Do not use:
- historical commits
- prior successful deployments
- cached proof
- old screenshots
- assumptions
- “this worked before”

Only verify the current state now.

1. IDENTIFY CURRENT LOCAL HEAD
Return:
- local branch
- local HEAD SHA
- working tree clean/dirty
- uncommitted files

2. VERIFY CURRENT COMMIT EXISTS ON GITHUB
Check the exact local HEAD SHA against my GitHub repository.

Return:
- GitHub repository
- branch
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- local SHA exists on GitHub: true/false
- GitHub commit URL

If GitHub API returns 403 or rate limit:
- use another available GitHub read method
- verify through git remote/fetch if available
- do not claim success unless the exact SHA is confirmed remotely

3. IF LOCAL SHA IS NOT ON GITHUB
Push it now using the existing configured GitHub credentials.

Do not ask me for credentials unless a real request proves:
- missing credential
- 401
- 403 due to permission
- revoked/expired token

Return exact error if blocked.

4. VERIFY RENDER DEPLOYMENT
Check Render for the exact current GitHub SHA.

Return:
- Render service ID
- latest deployment ID
- deployed SHA
- deployment status
- live timestamp

If the exact SHA is not deployed:
- trigger deployment of that exact SHA
- wait until LIVE
- inspect build/startup logs if it fails

5. VERIFY PRODUCTION SHA
Call live production:

GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health
GET https://api.ivxholding.com/version

Return:
- HTTP status
- commit SHA from /health
- commit SHA from /version
- boot time
- timestamp

6. REQUIRED SHA PARITY

The following MUST match exactly:

LOCAL HEAD
=
GITHUB HEAD
=
RENDER DEPLOYED SHA
=
/health SHA
=
/version SHA

Return:

SHA_PARITY = TRUE

only if all five match.

7. LIVE FUNCTIONAL CHECK
After parity is true, run these against production:

- owner login
- member registration
- public chat
- owner AI
- one protected endpoint
- one unauthorized request

Return:
- endpoint
- HTTP status
- latency
- production SHA

8. FINAL RESPONSE FORMAT

Return only:

LOCAL SHA:
GITHUB SHA:
RENDER SHA:
/health SHA:
/version SHA:
SHA_PARITY:

DEPLOYMENT STATUS:
DEPLOYMENT ID:

OWNER LOGIN:
MEMBER REGISTRATION:
PUBLIC CHAT:
OWNER AI:
SECURITY CHECK:

REMAINING BLOCKER:

FINAL VERDICT:
VERIFIED LIVE
or
NOT VERIFIED LIVE

Rules:
- No historical evidence.
- No estimates.
- No “should be.”
- No “worked before.”
- No fabricated SHA.
- No fabricated deploy ID.
- No success claim unless current live evidence proves it.
